name: draft-update-attachments
description: saveDraft with draftId and attachments, on drafts seeded in the Drafts folder. The attachments of the old draft are kept and a new one is added (the draft carries both, decoded byte for byte), keepAttachments false drops them (the draft becomes a single text part), keepAttachments false with a new attachment keeps only the new one, a file is attached by path to a plain draft, the body of a forward draft is replaced while the forwarded message and its attachment stay, keepQuote false replaces the whole body of a reply draft and keeps its reply headers, a draft with a detached attachment (a link to a file, which is never opened) is refused with nothing changed unless keepAttachments is false. searchMessages on the Drafts folder shows that each old version is gone and that the refused draft is still there. Not covered: what a compose window shows when it reopens the rewritten draft. Nothing is sent.
